decisive_spans.text: Aspiration of the lesion yielded turbid fluid, but the lesion persisted despite repeated aspirations and antibiotic therapy.

Abdominal ultrasonography revealed an 11 × 7.5 × 11.2 cm predominantly anechoic, thick-walled lesion arising from the inferior surface of the liver, with low-level internal echoes and a homogeneous echogenic area in its superolateral portion.

response.rationale: D2 is strongly supported by the presence of a thick-walled anechoic lesion and turbid fluid aspiration, which are key indicators of an infected cyst. D4 is also supported by similar findings but D2 is a more general diagnosis that fits the description well.
